subject.title: refactor(macos): move PortGuardian state to SQLite

question: Should the macOS team accept this one-way PortGuardian storage cutover after the device-identity prerequisite lands, including its explicit downgrade limitation for older JSON-only app copies?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes durable host-global state ownership and process compatibility behavior; tests can validate mechanics, but maintainers must decide whether the upgrade and rollback contract is acceptable.

options.title: Review as a rebased stack
options.body: Merge the prerequisite, rebase this PR onto `main`, and require a redacted live migration and recovery transcript before landing.

options.title: Accept the downgrade boundary
options.body: Land the SQLite-only cutover while documenting that rollback to an older JSON-only build requires a compatible backup or re-upgrade.

recommendation.title: Review as a rebased stack
recommendation.body: Merge the prerequisite, rebase this PR onto `main`, and require a redacted live migration and recovery transcript before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: Steipete authored the paired native-state migration stack and can supply the final integrated proof and clarify the intended upgrade contract.
